summary: Frontend testing completed for Granular Permissions feature in YoneticilerPage. All 9 test cases passed successfully. The new permission system with 8 groups (Sayfa Erişimi, Muhasebe İşlemleri, Kurye İşlemleri, Zimmet İşlemleri, Market İşlemleri, Akademi İşlemleri, Vardiya İşlemleri, Sistem Ayarları) is fully functional.
critical_code_review_comments: PERMISSION_GROUPS constant is well-structured with 8 groups and proper icons
togglePermission, toggleAllInGroup, getGroupStatus functions work correctly
Collapsible component from shadcn UI is properly implemented
Switch component correctly toggles all permissions in a group
Active permission count (e.g., '6/7 aktif') updates dynamically
Yöneticiler permission is correctly marked as disabled (cannot be changed by regular admins)

tested_features.yoneticiler_page_opens: PASS - Page loads correctly with admin list
tested_features.yetki_ayarlari_modal_opens: PASS - Modal opens when clicking settings icon
tested_features.permission_groups_displayed: PASS - All 8 groups displayed with correct icons
tested_features.collapsible_groups: PASS - Groups expand/collapse correctly with chevron icons
tested_features.checkbox_toggle: PASS - Individual permissions can be toggled via checkbox
tested_features.group_switch_toggle: PASS - Switch toggles all permissions in group at once
tested_features.save_permissions: PASS - Kaydet button saves and shows success toast
tested_features.migration_permissions: PASS - Test Delete Admin has correct migrated permissions

context_for_next_testing_agent: Granular permissions feature is fully implemented and working. The YoneticilerPage now has 8 collapsible permission groups with individual checkboxes and group-level switches. Test Delete Admin (testdeleteadmin) can be used for testing permission changes. Super Admin (onurertas) has all permissions enabled.
